# Subway Seat for Obsidian

A full community theme: Walnut in dark mode, Enamel in light mode, and Tunnel as a Style Settings toggle or a CSS snippet. Headings run the 70s stripe from burnt orange to terracotta, and callouts, code, diffs, graph and canvas stay in the same warm room.

[Obsidian](https://obsidian.md) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/obsidian/) · Needs Obsidian 1.13+

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| All three | [`Subway Seat/manifest.json`](Subway%20Seat/manifest.json) | `.obsidian/themes/Subway Seat/manifest.json`; inside your vault's folder |
| All three | [`Subway Seat/theme.css`](Subway%20Seat/theme.css) | `.obsidian/themes/Subway Seat/theme.css`; inside your vault's folder |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`snippets/subway-seat-tunnel.css`](snippets/subway-seat-tunnel.css) | `.obsidian/snippets/subway-seat-tunnel.css`; inside your vault's folder; only needed without the Style Settings plugin |

## Turn it on

In Obsidian › Settings › Appearance:

```text
Themes › Subway Seat
Base color scheme › Dark for Walnut and Tunnel, Light for Enamel
Tunnel: Style Settings › Subway Seat › Tunnel (deeper dark), or CSS snippets › subway-seat-tunnel
```

## Follow light and dark

In Obsidian › Settings › Appearance:

```text
Base color scheme › Adapt to system
# Enamel while the system is light, Walnut (or Tunnel, if it's on) while it's dark
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `.obsidian/themes/Subway Seat/manifest.json`.
- Delete `.obsidian/themes/Subway Seat/theme.css`.
- Delete `.obsidian/snippets/subway-seat-tunnel.css`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.

Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py` (v0.3.0). Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
